about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Kings Mountain and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Lynne Farmer
reviews.text: Britt and Justin SAVED me from being stranded with a flat tire and no spare! They responded to my distress call well before my “roadside assistance “ offered by my auto insurance company. Professional and dependable and affordable! That’s what you need when you are 75 miles from your destination. *****

reviews.author: Jim Mannix
reviews.text: Unbelievably fast service. Had a blowout on 85 south. They arrived inside 29 minutes with reasonable price. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Logan Kolometz
reviews.text: My husband and I have relied on this towing company for years, and they have never let us down. Every single time we’ve needed help, whether it was a breakdown, a flat tire, to move a industrial size freezer, or just peace of mind on the road, they’ve been there quickly, professionally, and with genuine care. What sets them apart is not just their reliability, but their kindness. They always treat us with respect and make a stressful situation feel a little easier. Their drivers are prompt, knowledgeable, and willing to go the extra mile to make sure we’re safe and taken care of. In today’s world, it’s hard to find a business you can count on time and time again, but this company has earned our trust completely. We wouldn’t think of calling anyone else. Highly recommend to anyone looking for honest, dependable, and truly customer-focused towing service!

reviews.author: Shane Murray
reviews.text: Had one of my employees break down on hwy74 this morning. Called In A Minute Towing and they were super friendly and was Johnny on the spot with great pricing.

reviews.author: Billie Oliver
reviews.text: In A Minute Towing definitely deserves five stars! They have the best customer service and I’m so glad I chose them! Justin arrived very quickly, he and his wife were both extremely friendly and professional, and the price was great! I really appreciate their help and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Amber Garrison
reviews.text: “I had a great experience with In A Minute Towing and Recovery! They showed up quickly, handled everything with professionalism, and made a stressful situation so much easier. The driver was polite, knowledgeable, and took great care of my vehicle. It’s clear this company really values their customers, and I wouldn’t hesitate to call them again. Definitely the best towing service in town!”

reviews.author: Vampran
reviews.text: Unfortunately I have had to use this towing service twice in the last two weeks for two different vehicles, however fortunately this is an awesome company! Very knowledgeable people who care about their customers! Fast, friendly, reliable and very reasonably priced! If you need a tow call this company!

reviews.author: linkinlady06
reviews.text: These guys are awesome and very reasonably priced! Me and husband's car wouldn't start so we called our local Mr. Tire and they recommended In A Minute Towing to us and they were very helpful! They told us the price over the phone beforehand and did both cash or debit at pick up which was fantastic! They got to us within 20 mins and handled everything perfectly and got us to were we needed to go! Would definitely use them again we're very thankful for their help.

reviews.author: richkdh76
reviews.text: The absolute best towing company in the West of Charlotte areas. Prompt and fair priced. Top notch!!!

reviews.author: Sally Fitzgerald
reviews.text: The best family owned towing company in town. I was in a pretty bad wreck on my way home from work. They were about to head to one of their kids orientation for school but heard how upset I was with being in the wreck. They came to my wreck scene to tow my car for me. This is a true meaning of family. They made my whole process a breeze when having to get my stuff out of my car to the insurance guy coming out to inspect the damages to them coming to get my car after they totaled it. I would not use any other towing coming. They are passionate about their customers. They are wonderful and caring people. Thank you guys for all of your help in my time of need.

reviews.author: Tim Cochran
reviews.text: Never had a towing company to provide the service we get from these guys. I’m a local roofing contractor with several trucks, vans on the road and have used them numerous times. They are always there to help , even towing one of my employees truck from Charlotte. Great to have a local towing service that lives up to their name ( In a Minute) . Save some time and call them first.

reviews.author: hayley borders
reviews.text: Thank you to Brittany & Justin for coming to our rescue tonight. They went above & beyond for us. Wrapped my windshield so that water wouldn’t get in my car from the rain we’re getting right now, got my daughters food out of my car that was left in it, and sent me more clear pics of my car once they unloaded it. Thank you to In a Minute Towing. I highly recommend this business.

reviews.author: Torrence Woodcraft
reviews.text: I ended up getting my truck and fully loaded trailer stuck at the bottom of a slippery slope after a heavy rain. At 10.30 I called In a Minute and literally within minutes Justin came to the rescue. He managed to pull the truck and trailer out within no time at all. Very thankful for his skill, quality equipment and professionalism. I highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Becky Walker
reviews.text: I have to say this is one of the best family owned business in kings mountain. They are prompt, reliable, and have great people skills. I would recommend In A Minute Towing to anyone. I have needed their assistance more than once and have always's been completely satisfied

reviews.author: Brock Ellis
reviews.text: Best towing company around. Great friendly people who really care. They are fast, reliable, and affordable. I would pay extra if I had to choose between them and another company because I know that they truly care about their customers.

reviews.author: Amber Ivester
reviews.text: Five stars!! Arrived much earlier than planned and was very polite and professional! Nice new truck and took great care of my car! Will definitely be the guy I call from now on!!!

reviews.author: KingKirksey
reviews.text: I have been using this towing company ever since they first open always have the best price when towing my car. Thank you In A Minute Towing. Please keep up the good work and stay safe out there.

reviews.author: Tessa Price
reviews.text: Even with a few people ahead of me it didn’t take long as long as I thought for them to arrive. The driver was sweet and helpful. Hopefully I won’t find myself in that situation again, but if I do I wouldn’t hesitate to give them another call.

reviews.author: Belinda Snowball
reviews.text: Great customer service. They were very understanding since I was stranded on the side of the road with my car. I would highly recommend them for any towing needs.

reviews.author: William Bowen
reviews.text: 1 word, AWESOME! Local Family Owned business, very attentive to their customer needs, and timeline. About 2 years working with them and their rates cannot be beat. I know, I have tried just to see.

reviews.author: Betsy Logeman
reviews.text: In a Minute is a terrific towing company. They rescued my poor van and towed it to the shop. They are fast, courteous and careful! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Steven Vickers
reviews.text: I use Justin and Britt exclusively, he has come to my rescue several times and hauls my project car where it needs to go be cause I know I can trust him and prices are more than fair.

reviews.author: Tyler Whisnant
reviews.text: Awesome family owned business. With the best prices. Fast and friendly. Make them your first call for a tow.

reviews.author: Brandon Lekopites
reviews.text: The guy who drives the truck the owner is really nice and so is his wife in the office but their not available much. Prices are right if their not busy that day

reviews.author: Just Ask
reviews.text: Friendly, good price, great service. Family owned and operated. If you are looking for great service and shop small business then this is it.

reviews.author: EMFLC
reviews.text: They are absolutely wonderful... were there to get us within 20 minutes. Great prices and great people!

reviews.author: Montez Moore
reviews.text: Didn't even answer the phone when needed and then called me back the following day...AFTER I'd gotten my car towed. I just let it ring. Thanks for absolutely nothing
